full_page.content:
1948, January 23
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
1948, January 23rd.
Bles'd be God in all His designs!
God bless you Mrs. M. J. Turner -- you and yours:
Many thanks for your charitable favor of Dec. 22nd duely received and noted. Only To-day, however, did read it.
I've been "half down" for several weeks and have not been in condition. Thanks be to God for it all and that things are clearing up again . . You were right about the Poor Souls, I did refer to those in Purgatory primarily. You idea further is right too. So many poor Souls.
I am glad to know that you know from actual experience so much about the benefits of the Ser. Mass Ass'n. I have forgotten the particulars of your trouble but your idea of doing something in thanksgiving for the favor you hope to receive is certainly practical -- just as I often suggest. I hope it brings the hoped-for results.
Hoping this finds you improved and improving, I beg to remain,
Sincerely
,
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
